scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,agent -c blue,green -k "npm run dev --prefix web" "cd agent && uv run main.py"
scripts.check: npm run lint --prefix web && npx --prefix web tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm test --prefix web && cd agent && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest -q
scripts.evals: cd agent && uv run python -m evals.run
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix web && cd agent && uv sync
